title: Monochrome Social: choose the structure
question: Three structures for the new Social page, all in Monochrome's existing world. Pick one to build, steer it, or re-roll. Desktop + mobile comps and the full write-up: http://localhost:5173/.impeccable/mocks/decision/board.html (sample data throughout).

options.label: The Crate
options.lineage: A record-store shelf: spines filed in time, the records playing now pulled out face-forward, shelf-talker cards for notes.
options.thesis: The whole instance's day is one shelf, and what's playing right now is pulled out face-forward at its right end.
options.viewport: A full-width shelf: hour-marked spines of today's plays lead left to right into large face-out sleeves of the live listeners, avatars on the sleeve corners and progress along each sleeve; shelf-talker notes clipped in front; the week's chart and kindred listeners below. Mobile comp: crate-mobile.png.
options.risk: Sideways spine titles read slowly and history scrolls sideways; spines need hover/focus labels and keyboard paging. (The comp's wood ledge is the image model's; the build keeps Monochrome charcoal.)

options.label: Gatherings
options.lineage: People clustering around a record at a party: live listening grouped by the music it shares, not by person.
options.thesis: Live listening is grouped into gatherings around a shared track, album or artist, so the page shows where the room is, not who is online.
materials: floor washed by the largest cover
options.viewport: A wide floor of gatherings: the largest shared cover centred with every listener's avatar seated along its edge, solo listeners smaller around it; a notes strip of avatars with thought bubbles above; earlier gatherings and the week's chart below. Mobile comp: gatherings-mobile.png.
options.risk: When nobody overlaps, every gathering is a gathering of one and the floor reads as separate cards; resizing as people join must not churn.

options.label: The Setlist
options.lineage: A gig's running order taped to the stage: numbered songs, set breaks, margin notes, an encore.
options.thesis: The instance's night reads as one running order: now playing at the top, earlier sets below, and one button plays the room.
options.viewport: Two columns: a setlist with a Now block of large-art rows (live progress, numbered, Play the room) followed by hour-grouped earlier sets with margin notes; an encore column with the week's chart, kindred listeners and a poll. Mobile comp: setlist-mobile.png.
options.risk: It is the closest of the three to a feed and the least spectacular; it lives or dies on typographic scale.
